purpose: Carry actually read choice-changing conditions into review arguments, including input change, objective change, compound concerns and route-specific deliverables.
minimum_consumer: One paragraph or one-page table with the existing source ledger/review map; no new schema or mandatory machine fields.

routes.process: Compare the preserved draft with actually read source passages; identify the missing choice relation.
routes.input_use: Source text defines the reported method/conditions; it supplies no new experiment.
routes.next_action: Write supported prose/table and attach it to the existing concern and review map.
routes.artifact: Actual revised argument plus unresolved subrelations, exemplified by mast-resynthesis.md.
routes.acceptance: Exact source support and a readable condition–choice–evaluation argument; remaining broader obligations visible.

routes.process: Name a missing relation, choose an eligible original/author manuscript/equivalent source, read bounded relevant content.
routes.input_use: The selected source supplies the missing relation or comparison; discovery and acquisition are separate states.
routes.next_action: Use the actual passages to revise the argument or retain a specific gap on failure.
routes.artifact: Reading locators and used argument, or an actual access/gap disposition; a download alone is insufficient.
routes.acceptance: Read version supports this relation and scope; source and relationship denominators remain distinct.

routes.process: Define the discriminating question, target unit, comparison/reference and evaluation before execution.
routes.input_use: Each data/model/reference input has its research use; explanatory text is not a new measured result.
routes.next_action: Deliver a design; execute only within research authorization; update the claim using actual results.
routes.artifact: Design first; execution receipts and result artifacts only after actual execution.
routes.acceptance: Judge observed results for the selected scientific question; planned or blocked work remains separate.

anti_overfitting: No universal list of R1 method names, branch/paper quota, required followup download or all-route execution.
A source name, a method name or five filled dimensions does not establish scientific sufficiency.
Equivalent evidence and justified scoped use are permitted.
OR routes remain optional; their unanswered original questions remain visible.
